title: Juche: Speeches and Writings
author: Kim Il Sung
desc: Discursos sobre la ideología Juche: autosuficiencia nacional como camino al socialismo.
tesis: Compilación de discursos donde Kim Il Sung expone la ideología Juche como adaptación coreana del marxismo-leninismo: la autosuficiencia (chaju) en política, la autodefensa en lo militar y la autarquía en economía. El Juche pone al ser humano como centro y motor de la revolución y enfatiza la independencia nacional como principio rector.
ideas: El Juche es la adaptación coreana del marxismo-leninismo: autosuficiencia como principio rector.
Cada pueblo debe encontrar su propio camino al socialismo — el Juche rechaza la imitación mecánica de modelos extranjeros.
La independencia nacional es condición previa de cualquier revolución social.
contexto: Compilación publicada en 1982 por las Ediciones en Lenguas Extranjeras de Pyongyang. Kim Il Sung (1912-1994) comenzó a formular la idea Juche en los años 1950, distanciándose de la URSS y China. Estos discursos abarcan desde los años 1960 hasta los 1980, período en que el Juche se consolidó como ideología oficial.

conexiones.razon: Los Discursos son aplicaciones prácticas de la Idea Juche teorizada en On the Juche Idea.
Stalin teorizó la cuestión nacional; Kim la resolvió con la autosuficiencia como principio.

tl: Anexion japonesa: Corea convertida en Estado policial

Thus, six years later, Japan's forceful annexation of Korea took place. And, overnight, Korea was turned into a fascist police state. The 'Japanese Thought Police' tried to control the thoughts and feelings of every Korean.
Nace Kim Il Sung en Mangyondae, cerca de Pyongyang
Kim Il Sung (or Kim Sung Ju, his name at birth) was born into a poor peasant family in Mangyondae, near Pyongyang, on April 15, 1912. Many of his ancestors were patriots and revolutionaries.
Funda la Down-With-Imperialism Union
In the autumn he formed an illegal revolutionary organization, the Down-With-Imperialism-Union, which was intended to defeat Japanese imperialism and build communism in Korea.
Primera formulacion del Juche: independencia coreana

It is absolutely impossible to achieve independence with foreign aid. The only way is for us Koreans to fight and defeat the Japanese imperialists by our own strength. To do so, an armed struggle must be waged.
Funda el Ejercito Guerrillero Antijapones

On April 25, 1932, Kim Il Sung founded the Anti-Japanese Guerrilla Army. Composed of workers, peasants, and youths, it was based on the principle of Marxism-Leninism, and was the first army of its kind to be formed in a colonial country.
Liberacion de Corea y division en el paralelo 38

The Allied victory in 1945 did not bring to Korea the 'liberty and independence' promised at Yalta; instead, it brought the tragic division of the small peninsula, the U.S.S.R. occupying the country north and the U.S. south of the 38th parallel.
Reforma agraria y nacionalizacion de la industria

On March 5, 1946, the Law of Land Reform was passed. The next important reform was the Nationalization of Industries on August 10, 1946. All those industries which had belonged to the Japanese and their allies were nationalized.
Fundacion de la RPDC y nueva Constitucion
In 1948 Kim drafted the Constitution of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The Assembly adopted the constitution proposed by Kim and appointed him premier of the cabinet.
Desembarco de Inchon: contraofensiva estadounidense
In September 1950, the U.S. conducted a landing operation on the Inchon area by mobilizing over three hundred warships, one thousand planes, and fifty thousand troops.
Estalla la Guerra de Corea: junio de 1950

On June 26, 1950, according to the North Koreans, the U.S. and the Syngman Rhee government attacked North Korea. Kim Il Sung was appointed Chairman of the Military Commission and Supreme Commander of the Korean People's Army.
Inicio de las negociaciones de armisticio
On July 10, 1951, armistice negotiations were begun. They were ineffectual, however, and the war continued. During the war, officers' schools and training centers were either set up or expanded.
Armisticio: fin de la Guerra de Corea

On July 27, 1953, the war ended and North Korea was again free to use its energies for its own development. On February 7 of that year, Kim Il Sung had been awarded the title of Marshal of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Proclamacion del Juche como politica oficial del Partido

In 1955 our Party set forth the definite policy of establishing Juche, and ever since then it has conducted a vigorous ideological struggle to carry it through. The year 1955 marked a turning point against dogmatism.
Kim fecha en 1955 el inicio del Juche
In view of this, in 1955 our Party set forth the definite policy of establishing Juche, and ever since then it has conducted a vigorous ideological struggle to carry it through.
Movimiento Chollima y socializacion total
By August 1958, all of North Korea was socialized, both in industry and agriculture. The Chollima movement is the general line of our Party in socialist construction.
Establecer el Juche como principio rector

The establishment of Juche means holding fast to the principle of solving for oneself all the problems of the revolution and construction in conformity with the actual conditions of one's country, mainly by one's own efforts.
Juche, independencia, autosuficiencia y autodefensa
Juche in ideology, independence in politics, self-sustenance in the economy, and self-defense in national defense—this is the stand our Party has consistently adhered to.
Construir una economía nacional independiente

Economic independence is an indispensable requisite for the building of an independent state, rich, strong, and enlightened. Without building an independent national economy, it is impossible to insure the firm political independence of the country.
Conferencia de Yakarta: Juche para el Tercer Mundo
Juche in ideology, independence in politics, self-sustenance in the economy, and self-defense in national defense, this is the stand our Party has consistently adhered to.
Conferencia de Yakarta: Juche para el Tercer Mundo
Lecture delivered at the Ali Archam Academy of Social Sciences, Jakarta, Indonesia, on April 14, 1965.
Frente unido anti estadounidense
It is necessary, therefore, to form the broadest possible anti-U.S. united front to isolate U.S. imperialism completely, and hit it in unity wherever it extends its talons of aggression.
Frente unido anti estadounidense
Article published in the Inaugural Issue of the Theoretical Magazine Tricontinental, Organ of the Organization of Solidarity of the Peoples of Asia, Africa, and Latin America, on August 12, 1967.
Por una economía autosuficiente frente al imperialismo
The formation of the socialist market dealt a mortal blow to the capitalist monopolies and multimillionaires that had assumed complete control of the world economy through their vast market.
Programa político ante la Asamblea Suprema
Political program of the Government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea announced at the First Session of the Fourth Supreme People's Assembly of the D.P.R.K., December 16, 1967.
Economia nacional independiente: condicion del Juche
A country which is dependent on foreign forces economically becomes a satellite of other countries politically, and an economically subjugated nation cannot get out of colonial slavery politically.
La ayuda imperialista como herramienta neocolonial
The imperialist policy of economic subjugation vis-a-vis developing countries is one of the most important characteristics of neocolonialism.
Respuestas a la agencia iraquí de noticias
Answers to the Questions Raised by the Iraqi News Agency (July 1, 1969).
Respuestas a la juventud comunista finlandesa
Answers to the Questions Raised by the Delegation of the Democratic Youth League of Finland for the "Kansan Uutiset," the Central Organ of the Communist Party of Finland. September 2, 1969.
Periodistas progresistas contra el imperialismo yanqui

Congratulatory Speech delivered at the International Conference on the Tasks of Journalists of the Whole World in Their Struggle against the Aggression of U.S. Imperialism, held in Pyongyang on September 18, 1969.
El sistema colonial imperial se desmorona

As a result of powerful thrusts by the movement of national liberation, the shackles of colonial slavery are being broken the world over, and the colonial system of imperialism is splitting at the seams.
Aplicación creativa de Marx y Lenin desde Corea

Our Party has attained great victories and successes in the socialist revolution and socialist construction by adhering firmly to the Juche line of creatively applying Marxist-Leninist universal principles with the experiences of other countries to suit our country's historical conditions and national peculiarities.
Centenario de Lenin en Pravda
Article published in Pravda, organ of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, on the occasion of the Centenary of the Birth of V. I. Lenin, April 16, 1970.
Sesenta cumpleanos de Kim Il Sung: publicacion en Occidente

To Marshal Kim Il Sung On the occasion of his sixtieth birthday. Juche! The Speeches and Writings of Kim Il Sung. English language translation Copyright 1972 by The Viking Press, Inc. First published in 1972 by Grossman Publishers.
